about: Listed / notable buildings of Skvyra. Coordinates from Wikidata (P625). Attributes are ESTIMATES read from the listed licensed photos (method photo_estimate, confidence medium), never measurements. Photos are referenced, not redistributed.

landmarks.name: Будівля чоловічої гімназії (Сквирський ліцей)
landmarks.evidence: Two tall storeys of ochre-salmon tile-clad brick, grey sheet-metal hipped roofs with pediments (pediments not modelled). Domed corner tower modelled from photos: three-quarter cylinder on the south-west corner of the south wing (position inferred from the tower close-up - both adjoining walls recede symmetrically, so it stands on a convex corner - and from a geotagged 2019 photo taken 5 m from that corner showing the adjoining facades); diameter ~7 m from 5 window bays on the visible half-circumference; white drum with ~8 round windows, ribbed grey metal dome. All tower dimensions are estimates.
landmarks.license: CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons - photos by Xsandriel (2025, 3 files) and WestBam (2019); referenced, not redistributed

landmarks.name: Костел Святого Яна Непомука
landmarks.evidence: Classicist plastered (white/grey, weathered) single-nave church with a pedimented gable and pilasters; roof of corrugated sheets. Height read from photos as about two tall storeys; towers or interior not modelled.
landmarks.note: Only footprint at the coordinate is a merged Microsoft ML outline (2,279 m2); no OSM footprint exists. Needs mapping in OSM.

landmarks.name: Будинок земської управи
landmarks.evidence: Two storeys, salmon/peach plaster with white trim and arched windows, brown metal-tile hipped roof with gabled dormers (dormers not modelled).

landmarks.name: Особняк Бабаєва
landmarks.evidence: One tall storey plus an attic with dormers, grey plaster with brick accents, brown metal roof (attic dormers not modelled).

landmarks.name: Будинок, у якому жив та працював М. Т. Рильський (дитсадок «Світанок»)
landmarks.evidence: Terracotta-red plaster with white pilasters and white window frames, brown roof; one storey judged from the eaves height in the photo.

landmarks.name: Синагога (Сквира)
landmarks.evidence: Identity: Commons category 'Synagogue in Skvyra' is the Wikidata item's P373; a 2025 photo geotag falls inside the OSM footprint; 2007-2025 photos by six authors show the same building (painted pink in 2008, red brick after the renovation of ~2018-2019). Observed: three blocks along a 51 m south front - west block with a south-facing gable and a Star-of-David gable window (2 storeys over a rubble-stone semi-basement; it is the 5.6 m projection of the OSM outline), central two-storey block with a stepped brick attic over the entrance, eastern prayer hall with a door and 8 tall round-arched windows; red brick, grey rubble-stone plinth, dark metal roofs, brick corbel frieze under the eaves, two stone stairs along the facade. Estimated (from frontal photos, scale from door heights): block lengths 9 / 18 / 24 m, eaves 5.9 / 5.6 / 4.5 m, roof rises, attic size, stair and door positions. Not visible / assumed: rear and roof plan behind the front, exact window counts on the north side.
landmarks.license: CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons - measurement photos by Michael Byalsky (2019, 4 files), Oleksandr Mykhaylyk (2019) and Xsandriel (2025); referenced, not redistributed
landmarks.status_note: Historic building, NOT a protected monument: it is in the Wiki Loves Monuments 'Jewish heritage' list (ID 99-322-4001) with the entry 'охоронний номер: (не охороняється)', and Wikidata has no heritage designation (P1435). Checked 2026-11-14.
